item.text: {"branches":[{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if changing livebait status produces no measurable change in fish caught per hour after controlling for hours, group composition, and camper status.","hypothesis_id":"H1","intervention":"Compare otherwise similar fishing groups using live bait versus groups not using live bait.","mechanism":"Live bait increases effective attraction and capture probability, raising the hourly catch rate.","mechanism_key":"livebait_effect_positive","predictions":[{"direction":"higher","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The livebait group has an equal or lower estimated fish-caught-per-hour rate than the non-livebait group.","observable":"Mean fish caught per hour (fish_caught divided by hours)","prediction_id":"P1","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if live bait is associated with a higher fish-caught-per-hour rate after controlling for the listed covariates.","hypothesis_id":"H2","intervention":"Compare otherwise similar fishing groups using live bait versus groups not using live bait.","mechanism":"Live bait is used in poorer fishing conditions or by less effective fishers, producing a lower hourly catch rate despite the bait.","mechanism_key":"livebait_effect_negative","predictions":[{"direction":"lower","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The livebait group has an equal or higher estimated fish-caught-per-hour rate than the non-livebait group.","observable":"Mean fish caught per hour (fish_caught divided by hours)","prediction_id":"P2","value_range":null}]},{"elimination_condition":"Eliminate if the livebait and non-livebait groups show a clear directional difference in fish caught per hour after controlling for the listed covariates.","hypothesis_id":"H3","intervention":"Compare otherwise similar fishing groups using live bait versus groups not using live bait.","mechanism":"Live bait does not materially affect catchability; observed rate differences arise from other factors such as effort, group composition, or fishing conditions.","mechanism_key":"livebait_effect_null","predictions":[{"direction":"no_difference","discriminator_id":"D1","failure_condition":"The estimated livebait and non-livebait hourly catch rates differ beyond the prespecified practical-equivalence margin.","observable":"Mean fish caught per hour (fish_caught divided by hours)","prediction_id":"P3","value_range":null}]}],"budget_units":3,"question":"How many fish on average do visitors catch per hour, and does livebait causally influence that hourly catch rate?"}
